SELECT expiring, expired, low_stock FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(is_expiring), 0) AS expiring, COALESCE(SUM(is_expired), 0) AS expired FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13'::date AND "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-12-13'::date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_expiring", CASE WHEN "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-11-13'::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_expired" FROM "inventory_lot" WHERE "inventory_lot"."available_quantity" > 0) AS lot_rows) AS lot_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_stock FROM (SELECT "catalog_product"."id" AS "pk" FROM "catalog_product" INNER JOIN "catalog_category" ON ("catalog_product"."category_id" = "catalog_category"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "inventory_lot" ON ("catalog_product"."id" = "inventory_lot"."product_id") WHERE ("catalog_category"."is_active" AND "catalog_product"."is_active") GROUP BY 1, "catalog_product"."minimum_stock" HAVING COALESCE(SUM("inventory_lot"."available_quantity") FILTER (WHERE ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13'::date)), 0) <= ("catalog_product"."minimum_stock")) AS critical_rows) AS critical_totals
